The reasons for the increase in revenue cited by the company are, in the Domestic Business, an increase in customer numbers at existing stores due to pricing strategies and sales promotion measures responding to changes in customer behavior, strong performance of IP content products and trend products, a record-high update of tax-free sales, and the opening of 25 new stores. In the North America Business, revenue increased due to new store openings in California, the consolidation of Mikuni Restaurant Group, Inc. as a subsidiary, and foreign exchange effects, while the loss of stores in wildfires and the closure of unprofitable stores were factors in the decrease. In the Asia Business, it reviewed the product composition (MD composition) in each area, strengthened procurement using local distribution channels, increased price competitiveness, and customer numbers increased.

entries.d4535fa1b0554f6a: In Japan, this is the largest of the three reportable segments, operating the big convenience and discount store "Don Quijote," the family-oriented general discount stores "MEGA Don Quijote" and "MEGA Don Quijote UNY," and the general supermarkets "Apita" and "Piago." The new food-focused format "Kyoraku no Denden Robin Hood" opened its first store in April 2026, and had five stores by June 2026. The number of domestic stores at the end of June 2026 was 676, and during the period four stores in Japan were closed. In the sales table, "other revenue" of ¥113,092 million (up 153.1% year on year) is included in the domestic business, in addition to the discount store and UNY businesses.

entries.f69146a7a6f7c8fd: In Japan, it operates discount-format stores such as "Don Quijote," "MEGA Don Quijote" and "MEGA Don Quijote UNY," and general supermarkets such as "Apita" and "Piago." Its products are food, daily goods, watches and fashion goods, sports and leisure goods, home appliances, and other products. The company regards the 3 points of "more conveniently," "more cheaply" and "more enjoyably" as the purchasing motivations customers seek from retail, and, from their initials, sets its business concept as "CV+D+A." In April 2026, it opened the first store of the new food-enhanced format "Kyogaku no Dendo Robin Hood," and by June 2026 there were 5 stores. As of the end of June 2026, the number of stores was 676 in Japan and 123 overseas, for a total of 799 (779 at the end of June 2025). In North America, it operates discount stores, supermarkets and other stores in Hawaii and California, and in Asia it operates "DON DON DONKI." In addition, it provides financial services such as credit cards, electronic money and insurance agency services, leases business properties and tenant spaces, and manufactures and sells boxed meals for convenience stores.
entries.f6a9b0276057126e: In October 2007, the company acquired Nagasakiya Co., Ltd. (now a consolidated subsidiary) and its 7 subsidiaries and made them subsidiaries, bringing the number of group stores to 200.
entries.f8cba2fa05283e79: In January 2019, the company acquired all shares in UNY Co., Ltd. (now a consolidated subsidiary) and made that company and its 8 subsidiaries subsidiaries.
entries.f8e7944a2a6b2001: In August 2017, the company concluded an agreement on a capital and business alliance with UNY-FamilyMart Holdings Co., Ltd. (now FamilyMart Co., Ltd.), and in November it acquired part of the shares in UNY Co., Ltd. and made that company an equity-method affiliate. In September, it acquired all shares in QSI, Inc., which operates 24 supermarkets in the State of Hawaii in the United States, and made it a subsidiary. In November, with the opening of the MEGA Don Quijote Kyoto Yamashina store and the MEGA Don Quijote Claspo Gamagori store, the number of group stores reached 400.
entries.fb63b08b4dd090dd: Net sales in the fiscal year ended June 2024 were ¥2,095,077 million. Net sales were ¥2,445,260 million in the fiscal year ended June 2026 (¥2,246,758 million in the fiscal year ended June 2025), and net sales over the 5 years increased in every fiscal year.
entries.fcd477c295f106a5: In March 1989, to sell good products to consumers more cheaply, the company opened the Don Quijote Fuchu store in Fuchu, Tokyo, as its first store, and changed its main business form from wholesaling to retailing.
entries.feaeb50c202cc990: With the addition of the corporate group operating Gelson's, supermarkets in California joined the North America business.
